/help                           list available commands
/usage                          show cumulative and last-turn token usage
/new                            start a new, unsaved session
/save [name]                    save the current session to disk
/load <name>                    load a saved session from disk
/clear                          clear the terminal scrollback (the conversation history is kept)
/compact                        summarize older turns now and report the token estimate
/exit                           save the session and exit, like Ctrl+D
/cd <path>                      re-root the workspace sandbox
/model <name> [context-window]  switch models, validated against the active provider
